name: bq-penalties-corrections
description: Analyse selected 2026 BES administrative tax and customs penalties, voluntary corrections and ex officio reductions. Use to separate a statutory ceiling from policy, filing from payment, default from intent or gross negligence, and general tax from customs. Includes primary law, current penalty policy, notice and evidence safeguards, limitation rules and fictional monetary components. This source-cited draft holds actual culpability, disputed policy mapping, mandatory correction delegation, criminal proceedings and live submissions. Load with the universal workflow base and BES compliance references; professional review remains required.
